licence.scope: Owner is ESA (INTEGRAL Optical Monitoring Camera). ESA ESDC archive terms (step 2; followed GAIA__GAIA): CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, non-commercial reuse with the mission credit line; commercial use needs ESA authorisation. The ESDC page covers data hosted in the ESA Space Science Archives and does not name the filter curves; the page SVO cites (https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/integral/instruments-omc) carries no licence statement. Source page SVO cites: https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/integral/instruments-omc. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
